name: p7.10-client-demo-transcripts
description: Runnable, privacy-safe client demo transcripts for every generic client classification.

shared_contract.decision_boundary: The model owns strategy; the harness owns permissions, freshness, audit, verification, privacy, and side-effect contracts.

transcripts.value_claim: A finance reviewer can see that discovery-profile sidecar calls deny mutation before execution and still return a typed, auditable contract result.
transcripts.selling_point: Idiom sells local permission and audit evidence, not a finance compliance product.
transcripts.mvp_limitation: Proof-only: no regulated finance, FINRA, retention, or formal compliance claim is made in the MVP demo.
transcripts.final_state_expansion: A later regulated package can add reviewed control mapping, retention export, procurement artifacts, and support posture after P7.9/P9.9 review.
transcripts.privacy_posture: Metadata-only demo posture: no raw prompt, no raw file body, no secrets, no private paths, no account data, and no customer identifiers are expected in fixture or generated output.

pass: The command exits non-zero with profile_denied before writing.
The output contains stable sidecar contract and audit fields.
No raw prompt, file body, credential, private repo, account, or customer identifier appears.
no_go: The call writes a file, leaks command content, or returns unstructured prose only.
The demo is used as a finance compliance claim.

transcripts.release_claim_impact: Allows only a proof-only finance demo claim; no regulated compliance, retention, attestation, sales, or release-readiness claim is supported.

transcripts.final_state_expansion: A later public-sector package can add reproducible release bundles, checksums, offline install paths, policy retention, and reviewed support boundaries.

transcripts.privacy_posture: Metadata-only demo posture: no raw prompt, no raw file body, no secrets, no private paths, no private repo URLs, and no customer identifiers are expected in fixture or generated output.

transcripts.final_state_expansion: A community package can add polished quickstart fixtures, cleanup reporting, retained-use examples, and privacy-safe product-evidence exports.
transcripts.privacy_posture: Metadata-only demo posture: no raw prompt, no raw file body, no secrets, no private paths, no private repo URLs, and no hosted telemetry are expected in fixture or generated output.
